content:
HCL paid $1.8 billion for IBM's software portfolio. The same price Adobe paid for Magento. One deal sparked years of debate. The other? Silence.

In this issue

  • Where HCL Wins. HCL is a Challenger in both Gartner Magic Quadrants, Commerce and DXP.
  • The Honest Assessment. I'll give you both sides.
  • The So What. If you're already on IBM WebSphere Portal or WebSphere Commerce, HCL is your upgrade path.
